request.summary: Build a fixed 1920x1080 welcome screen for the fictional Calder Museum using the supplied geometric poster as the primary visual reference.
request.audience: Museum visitors viewing a full-HD entrance or lobby display from several metres away.
request.primaryGoal: Welcome visitors and communicate the current exhibition, venue, date, and supporting image with immediate poster-like hierarchy.

assumptions: The app is designed only for a fixed 1920x1080 placement because the requested composition depends on the supplied poster's exact landscape geometry.
Calder Museum and the WELCOME label are fixed brand copy; exhibition-specific content remains editable.
The packaged fictional sculpture image is the default; disabling image visibility or receiving broken media replaces it with an intentional concentric geometric motif.
The default Light theme follows the supplied poster; Dark and Custom themes preserve the same semantic color relationships.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The user explicitly requested a fixed 1920x1080 screen and the reference-led asymmetric poster composition relies on that canvas.

surfaces.purpose: Full-HD museum welcome display at the entrance or exhibition threshold.

dynamicText.fallback: Measured fitting reduces the title only to 64px and uses up to eight complete lines; deliberate word wrapping preserves the full title.
dynamicText.rationale: The exhibition name is the poster's main message and must remain complete, bold, and readable rather than ellipsized.

dynamicText.fallback: Measured fitting uses the complete subtitle across at most four lines, with a 34px readability floor.
dynamicText.rationale: The subtitle provides meaningful exhibition context and should remain complete within the right field.

dynamicText.fallback: Single-line fitting preserves the complete label with a 24px floor; representative stress copy is sized to remain within that limit.
dynamicText.rationale: Date and venue are operational details that must not be truncated on signage.

states.expectation: Only the museum name, welcome band, title, and geometric motif remain; hidden metadata does not leave accidental rules or gaps.
A pathological but plausible exhibition title and long metadata remain complete, bold, and readable without clipping or tiny type.
The circular field shows the intentional concentric fallback motif with no broken image indicator.
An invalid selected image fails closed to the concentric motif with no broken image icon or layout shift.
The full Custom palette changes coherently while preserving contrast and poster hierarchy.
The neutral ground becomes transparent over the checker preview while colored fields, text, and motif remain legible.

behaviors.expectation: Editor configuration updates change title and visibility in the mounted widget without remounting.
Theme preset and transparency updates immediately resolve the complete semantic palette.

visualDirection.summary: A sharp modernist museum poster with bold asymmetric typography, large primary color fields, a geometric circular image aperture, and deliberate negative space.
signatureChoices: A dominant vermilion title field with oversized tightly stacked uppercase type.
A cobalt welcome band and yellow information field joined by an off-centre concentric circular image aperture.
A restrained serif subtitle contrasts with the otherwise bold grotesque typography.
avoid: Dashboard chrome, cards, pills, navigation headers, pagination counters, soft gradients, rounded panels, and generic centered hero composition.

visualReview.intent: The finished screen should read as one confident exhibition poster at a distance, not as assembled interface panels.
focus: Verify the title remains the dominant complete message in every scenario, especially long-title, without clipped glyphs or unreadably small type.
Verify the circular image/motif bridges the neutral and information fields without exposing broken media or accidental empty space.
Verify every palette, including transparent background, preserves sharp color contrast and readable text.
Verify hidden elements collapse intentionally and do not leave orphan rules, labels, or unbalanced spacing.
